content: Czkawka/Krokiet (repo docs): Duplicates by name/size/hash (Blake3), reference paths ('Ref' checkbox) protected from any deletion; Select popup presets: all/none, one oldest/newest/biggest/smallest, except oldest/newest/..., shortest/longest path, invert, custom column filter; actions Move, Delete (permanent), Trash, Save/export, Hardlink/Softlink; presets save scan settings; shared hash cache incl. prehash cache, stopping a scan keeps computed hashes in cache; outdated cache cleanup weekly; context menu select-all-from-folder, exclude parent folder.
